title: Watch: How Microsoft services went down around the world
summary: Microsoft is struggling to fix a global outage, with services including Teams, Outlook and AI software Copilot affected by "connectivity problems".

blocks.text: Microsoft is struggling to fix a global outage, with services including Teams, Outlook and AI software Copilot affected by "connectivity problems". A monitoring website reports the outage is affecting users in 74 countries. So what's going on? The BBC's Claire Keenan explains everything we know so far.
